**Problem**

What you are trying to do, and what stops you today.

**Proposal**

What you would like ANet-Drone4D to do.

**Layer**

- [ ] Reality or Reconstruction
- [ ] World (World Package, geometry queries)
- [ ] Environment (wind, weather, visibility)
- [ ] Simulation (fleet, safety, missions, sensors)
- [ ] Agent (ANet collaboration)
- [ ] Web sandbox (rendering, UI)
- [ ] Tooling, docs or operations

**Contracts touched**

File formats, `awr.rt.v1`, REST, reason codes, bus keys or units in `packages/contracts/`. Changes here are
discussed in the issue before any PR.

**Related documents**

ADR numbers or module PRDs, for example `docs/03-设计基线与决策记录.md` ADR-047 or `docs/modules/M05-...`.
